title: CommitteeVote
description: Fixed-shape JSON vote submitted by a registered Investment Committee agent. Canonical: docs/product/20260623-product-proposal-investment-committee-v0.md §3 and docs/sprint/20260601-week-sprint.md §3 (Workstream A).

schema_version.description: Vote JSON schema version. Must be '1.0' for this revision.

agent_id.description: Human-readable identifier for the committee agent (e.g. 'athena-v1', 'robot-money', 'woon').

vault.description: Target vault address (one of the four PRD §11 vaults). 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex.

stance.description: Allocation tilt for the vault: overweight / neutral / underweight.

target_weight_bps.description: Target allocation weight in basis points (0–10 000). 10 000 bps = 100%.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence score for this vote (0–100).

rationale_uri.description: Public URI to the narrative chain-of-thought / memo (any readable format at any public host, e.g. GitHub gist, pastebin).

prompt_hash.description: keccak256 of the agent prompt used to produce this vote. Enables reproducibility verification.

inputs_digest.description: keccak256 of the inputs consumed (regime feed + holdings snapshot). Enables reproducibility verification.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds when the vote was formed by the agent.
